questions.q: What is the programme mainly about?
options: How to polish leather shoes quickly and well
Why more men are wearing sandals in the office
Whether high heels are about fashion, power or oppression
Health problems caused by wearing trainers every day
questions.why: Neil says they'll discuss whether high heels are a fashion statement or a sign of oppression.

questions.q: What have studies suggested about wearing high heels?
options: They can damage muscles and the skeleton
They improve balance and help you stand up straight
They make walking faster over short distances
They are good for posture and strengthen the back
questions.why: Neil says studies suggest they can damage the muscles and skeleton.

questions.q: Why are high heels still worn, despite the risks?
options: They are cheap and easy to buy
They are comfortable for long days
Doctors recommend them for bad backs
To look professional at work or glamorous
questions.why: Neil says they're worn to look professional in the workplace or for glamour.

questions.q: How does Tim Edwards describe women's high heels?
options: As boring, old-fashioned and uncomfortable
As having an almost magical, transforming quality
As only really useful for parties and weddings
As no different from men's smart shoes
questions.why: He says they have 'this kind of transformative or even magical quality'.

questions.q: According to Tim Edwards, how do high heels change a woman's experience?
options: They make her taller and change her balance
They make her walk more slowly
They make her feel less important
They make her feet warmer
questions.why: He says you're raised several inches higher and your balance is altered.

questions.q: What does Tim Edwards say about men's shoes compared with women's?
options: Men have many special styles to choose from
Men's shoes are more glamorous and exciting
It's hard to find anything similar for men
Men also often wear heels at work in offices
questions.why: He says it's difficult to draw parallels with men's shoes.

questions.q: How might a man wearing flamboyant shoes be seen, according to Tim Edwards?
options: As very fashionable, confident and successful at work
With suspicion about his sexuality, work or morals
As someone who works hard and cares about details
As a sportsman or someone who likes to dance
questions.why: He says such a man is viewed with suspicion about his sexuality, work ethic or morals.

questions.q: What is Rob's opinion of this view of men's shoes?
options: He completely agrees with it
He thinks it's a modern idea
He wants to wear high heels
He thinks it's quite old-fashioned
questions.why: He says, 'It sounds like quite an old-fashioned view.'
